name: jev-search
description: Web search through Jev Search. Answers Claude Code's built-in WebSearch with Jev (sources and time window chosen by Jev, every result ranked by relevance) and falls back to the built-in search when Jev cannot answer. Also adds the jev_search MCP tool for explicit source or time filters, and a skill on when to use it.

baseUrl.title: Jev Search instance
baseUrl.description: Origin of the Jev Search deployment to query. The public demo is rate limited to about 10 searches per minute per address; point this at your own deployment for heavier use.

intercept.title: Answer WebSearch with Jev
intercept.description: When on, every built-in WebSearch call is answered by Jev Search and falls back to the built-in tool only if Jev fails. Turn off to keep the built-in search and use the jev_search tool explicitly.

maxResults.title: Results per search
maxResults.description: How many ranked results a WebSearch answered by Jev returns.
